Class BenchmarkSeriesLoader

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reports.BenchmarkSeriesLoader
@Component public class BenchmarkSeriesLoader extends Object
Loads the quotes of a resolved benchmark and of its conversion rate for the valuation dates of a report and aligns them with BenchmarkSeries.
  • Only reliable quotes count: created by a connector, imported, calculated or entered by a user. Filled rows (non-trading days, linear fills, gaps filled by a connector) are never an observation.
  • Each leg starts with the latest reliable quote on or before the first valuation date, so no fixed lookback can hide a quote; BenchmarkSeries decides whether it is fresh enough.
  • A dividend-capable security has its recorded gross distributions reinvested. Every other instrument, among them indices and derived instruments, is compared as supplied.
  • The rate comes from the direct pair when it has reliable rates, otherwise from the inverse pair.
